content.title: Bicycling
content.summary: Arvada has been recognized as a Silver-level Bicycle Friendly Community and is actively enhancing its bike network through the Comprehensive Plan and Bike Master Plan. The city offers various resources for cyclists, including a bike loop map, seven bike repair stations, community bike rides, and a bicycle recycle program to provide bikes to those in need. Additionally, a data bike is used to gather information on the trail network, contributing to ongoing improvements in biking infrastructure.
content.body:
Ar![bike friendly community silver-level seal 2024-2028 from the league of american bicyclists](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5099)vada boasts a strong culture of recreational bicycle riding as a Silver-level [Bicycle Friendly Community](https://bikeleague.org/bfa/community/). The City plans for the future of Arvada's bike network through the Comprehensive Plan and [Bike Master Plan](/1477).

Arvada is continually working towards making it easier for people of all ages and abilities to ride a bike in a network that is easy, comfortable, and safe.

## Resources for Biking in Arvada

1. [Arvada Bike Loop](#taba33aa012-8161-4c5b-868f-acbf9e2a8502_0)

[The Bike Trail Loop Map (PDF)](https://co-arvada.civicplus.com/DocumentCenter/View/805) provides a connected route for exploring Arvada by bike. The map can be downloaded to your phone for quick reference. There are also signs along the route to keep you on track!

[![Map of the Arvada Bike Loop](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=795)](https://co-arvada.civicplus.com/DocumentCenter/View/805/Bike-Trail-Loop-Map-PDF?bidId=)

1. [Bike Repair Stations](#taba33aa012-8161-4c5b-868f-acbf9e2a8502_1)

The City has seven Bike Repair Stations around Arvada. The aid stations allow cyclists to place their bicycles on a rack and use the attached screwdrivers, open-end wrenches and Allen wrenches to make minor adjustments and repairs to the bike. Air is not provided at the station.

## Bike Repair Stations

- Olde Town Square
- Arvada Reservoir parking lot on the west end of the Ralston Creek Trail
- Gold Strike Park
- Ralston Central Park
- Stenger Soccer Complex/Van Bibber Trail
- Secrest Recreation Center
- Tomlinson Park

1. [Community Bike Rides](#taba33aa012-8161-4c5b-868f-acbf9e2a8502_2)

Bike Friendly Arvada leads to fun, free, family-friendly community bike rides all summer. [Visit the Bike Friendly Arvada website](https://www.meetup.com/bikefriendlyarvada-community-bike-rides/).

1. [Bike Recycle](#taba33aa012-8161-4c5b-868f-acbf9e2a8502_3)

### About the Bike Recycle Program

The Bicycle Recycle Program is a partnership with the Golden/Arvada Lake Arbor Optimists. Bikes that are no longer used are collected, refurbished, and then distributed to community members who cannot afford to buy one. Contact the Optimists for a year-round collection of unused bikes.

If you are in need of a bike but cannot afford one, or if you have a bike you'd like to donate please [email Optimist, Roy Dean](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#05626a6961606b6a75716c686c767176456268646c692b666a68).

1. [Data Bike](#taba33aa012-8161-4c5b-868f-acbf9e2a8502_4)

The data bike is an e-bike with a specialized app that gathers data on pavement roughness across our 130-mile trail network. The bike also has a 360-degree camera to capture Google Street imagery of our trail system for public use.

Learn more about the data collected on the [Active Transportation Data dashboard](https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/3bfb400d84464998a16ca3980e44f600).

![data bike on a trail](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2664)

1. [Bike Parking in Olde Town](#taba33aa012-8161-4c5b-868f-acbf9e2a8502_5)

Use the [**Bike Parking in Olde Town section of the ‘Connecting Arvada’ StoryMap**](https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/3bfb400d84464998a16ca3980e44f600#ref-n-y4ozqs) to see currently available parking options.

The City is working to improve bike parking options available to the community and people riding the G Line; to suggest improvements we should consider, please submit an [AskArvada](/898) ticket under ‘Bikes’.

### [FAQs](/Faq.aspx?TID=47)

[What is the Colorado Safety Stop Law?](#)
:   The Colorado Safety Stop Law makes it legal for cyclists (and other low-speed conveyances) to:

    - Treat stop signs like yield signs
    - Red traffic signals like stop signs

    After checking for traffic, cyclists can then proceed through the intersection.

    This helps move cyclists through the intersection and out of the high-conflict zone, improving safety for everyone.

    ![person on scooter bike and segway yeild at a stop sign](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5486)![person on scooter bike and segway thinking stop sign at a red traffic signal](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5489)

[What hand signals do cyclists use for turning?](#)
:   **Left turn:**cyclists should extend their left hand straight out from their side to indicate a left turn.

    **Right turn:** cyclists should raise their left hand in a 90 degree angle or extend their right hand straight out from their side to indicate a right turn.

    ![three figures on bikes making left and right hand turn signals](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5491)

[How does the City decide where to add bike lanes?](#)
:   The City must comply with the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) standards for all bike facilities. Additionally, the City maintains a [Bicycle Master Plan](https://www.arvadaco.gov/DocumentCenter/View/778/2017-Bicycle-Master-Plan-PDF) and is completing a Transportation System Plan, both of which help identify areas of opportunity and help inform planning for improvements related to cycling infrastructure in Arvada.
